source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseSystemExceptionGapFamilyTest { @isTest static void exercise() { QueryException cause = new QueryException('cause'); System.assertEquals('System.QueryException', new QueryException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.ProcedureException', new ProcedureException('procedure', cause).getTypeName()); Exception required0 = new RequiredFeatureMissingException(); Exception required1 = new RequiredFeatureMissingException('required'); Exception required2 = new RequiredFeatureMissingException(cause); Exception required3 = new RequiredFeatureMissingException('required', cause); System.assertEquals('System.RequiredFeatureMissingException', required0.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.RequiredFeatureMissingException', required1.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.RequiredFeatureMissingException', required2.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.RequiredFeatureMissingException', required3.getTypeName()); Exception sobject0 = new SObjectException(); Exception sobject1 = new SObjectException(cause); Exception sobject2 = new SObjectException('sobject'); Exception sobject3 = new SObjectException('sobject', cause); System.assertEquals('System.SObjectException', sobject0.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.SObjectException', sobject1.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.SObjectException', sobject2.getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('System.SObjectException', sobject3.getTypeName()); } }
